allSkyProjection.orientation: North at top. Center Galactic l=0,b=0. Longitude decreases left to right: left +180, center 0, right -180 (180). Latitude +90 at top to -90 at bottom. Pixel centers offset half a pixel from boundaries.
allSkyProjection.processing: HiPS2FITS reprojection of observed surveys, with contrast/color rendering, not synthetic sky. Not calibrated photometric images.
